promises.title: Complete the rural roads project to ensure at least 500 kilometers of farm roads are completed by 2024.
promises.promise_blog:
Let us consider the rural roads project and its vital role in advancing our farming communities. The primary aim of this initiative is to complete at least 500 kilometers of farm roads by 2024, a target with significant implications for regional development.

Improved rural road infrastructure will grant farmers reliable and efficient access to markets,reducing transportation costs and minimizing post-harvest losses. Smooth, well-maintained routes will replace the existing uneven pathways, facilitating the swift movement of agricultural produce and enhancing daily mobility for all community members.

Furthermore, upgraded roads will help facilitate strong connections with suppliers and customers, opening new avenues for trade and collaboration. By supporting this endeavor, the state government is investing in the prosperity and sustainable growth of its rural areas.
promises.description: Complete the rural roads project to ensure at least 500 kilometers of farm roads are completed by 2024.

promises.title: Design a sustainable program to clear outstanding salary and pension obligations.
promises.promise_blog:
The state government must prioritize the contributory pension scheme policy to safeguard the financial future of their employees as designing a sustainable program to address outstanding salary and pension obligations is not just a necessity; it’s a moral imperative.

 

By implementing  a structured plan that clears arrears, we can ensure that all workers receive their rightful wages and benefits, adhering to minimum wage standards. A robust strategy should include the allocation of bail-out funds specifically earmarked for settling these obligations. This approach not only alleviates immediate financial burdens but also fosters trust and loyalty among employees who deserve assurance regarding their pension entitlements. By committing to this sustainable program, companies can transition from reactive measures to proactive solutions that promote long-term stability and compliance with labor laws. Ultimately, investing in our workforce through timely salary payments and fulfilling pension commitments is essential for building a resilient organization poised for future growth. The government must take responsible action today to create a secure tomorrow for every employee under her care.
promises.description: Design a sustainable program to clear outstanding salary and pension obligations and ensure full compliance with the contributory pension scheme policy going forward

promises.title: Commence a digital training program to train at least 5000 youth in critical technology skills.
promises.promise_blog:
The digital divide in today’s fast-evolving economy puts thousands of young Nigerians at a stark disadvantage, limiting their ability to compete on the global stage. While tech giants relentlessly push the boundaries of innovation, too many talented youths lack access to essential digital training programs. As a result, they miss out on high-paying remote jobs, startup opportunities, and participation in the burgeoning digital economy. Launching a targeted digital training programme to equip at least 5,000 youth with critical technology skills is by no means optional but an urgent mandate for workforce development and national progress. By offering structured courses in software development, network administration, digital marketing, and UX/UI design, this initiative can bridge the skills gap between employers’ demands and graduates’ capabilities. 

 

Leveraging partnerships with tech incubators, multinational firms, and online learning platforms ensures access to industry-standard tools, mentorship, and real-world projects. Trainees will gain hands-on experience with relevant software packages like Python, SQL and Java. A stipend-supported model and weekend boot camps make the program inclusive for students, recent graduates, and young entrepreneurs, while a talent-matching service will connect graduates directly with local and international employers. The return on investment is immediate: a digitally literate workforce drives innovation and powers the growth of startups.
promises.description: Commence  a digital training program to train at least 5000 youth in critical technology skills required to be globally competitive

promises.title: Support the provision of affordable health insurance that guarantees access to basic healthcare for all.
promises.promise_blog:
Nigeria’s healthcare system continues to grapple with poor accessibility and high out‑of‑pocket costs, leaving millions of citizens unable to afford even basic medical services. According to the National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA), health insurance coverage grew from 16.7 million enrollees in 2023 to 19.2 million in 2024, representing a 14% increase in just one year. Despite this progress, coverage remains limited compared to Nigeria’s population of over 220 million, meaning the majority of citizens still lack financial protection against illness.

To close this gap, the Ekit state government has pledged to support the provision of affordable health insurance that guarantees access to basic healthcare for all. Expanding health insurance coverage will reduce the financial burden on households, ensure that essential services such as maternal care, child immunization, and treatment for common diseases are accessible, and create a safety net that protects citizens from catastrophic health costs.

The NHIA has already introduced programs such as the Group, Individual and Family Social Health Insurance Programme (GIFSHIP) and vulnerable group coverage to widen access. These schemes are designed to include informal sector workers, low‑income families, and other underserved populations. By scaling up these initiatives and ensuring affordability, Nigeria can significantly reduce poverty caused by health expenditures and improve national productivity.
promises.description: Support the provision of affordable health insurance that guarantees access to basic healthcare for all.

promises.title: Designate the Ipole-Iloro-Ikogosi corridor as a Special Tourism Zone
promises.promise_blog:
Ekiti State is blessed with some of Nigeria’s most captivating natural and cultural attractions, yet many remain underdeveloped and under‑promoted. The Ipole‑Iloro‑Ikogosi corridor is home to the famous Arinta Waterfalls in Ipole‑Iloro, the globally renowned Ikogosi Warm Springs, and surrounding lush landscapes that offer unique opportunities for eco‑tourism, cultural exploration, and leisure. Despite their potential, these sites have suffered from inadequate infrastructure, limited investment, and poor connectivity, preventing them from becoming the thriving tourism hubs they could be.  

 

Designating the corridor as a Special Tourism Zone would change this narrative. It would prioritize the area for targeted investment in roads, hospitality facilities, security, and environmental conservation. Such a designation would also attract private sector partnerships, create jobs for local communities, and generate revenue through increased visitor numbers. By clustering attractions within a defined zone, tourists would enjoy a seamless experience—moving from waterfalls to warm springs to cultural villages without facing logistical hurdles.  

 

Tourism is a proven driver of economic growth, and Ekiti has the advantage of natural assets that can rival destinations across Africa. A Special Tourism Zone would not only showcase these treasures but also integrate them into Nigeria’s broader tourism strategy, positioning Ekiti as a premier destination for both domestic and international travellers.
promises.description: Designate the Ipole-Iloro-Ikogosi corridor as a Special Tourism Zone

promises.title: Introduce coding camps and classes in primary and secondary schools across the state.
promises.promise_blog:
In recent years, the importance of technology and digital skills has become increasingly evident, especially in fostering innovation and preparing students for the demands of the digital economy. To address this need, coding camps and classes need to be introduced across primary and secondary schools with the aim of equipping young learners with essential skills that will empower them to thrive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

 

These coding boot camps offer workshops that focus on various aspects of programming and computer science. By engaging students in hands-on activities, they learn not only how to code but also develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills that are vital for success in any field. The curriculum should be designed to be accessible, ensuring that children from all backgrounds have opportunities to explore their interests in technology. These educational programs to open doors for the youth—providing them with the tools necessary to innovate and contribute meaningfully to society. By imbibing  a culture of learning around digital skills at an early age, a new generation of innovators can be inspired to take on future challenges.
promises.description: Introduce coding camps and classes in primary and secondary schools across the state

promises.title: Commence full passenger and cargo transportation at the new ado airport.
promises.promise_blog:
The excitement is palpable as the indigenous people of Ekiti celebrate the establishment of the new Ado Airport. This state-of-the-art facility is far from being just an airport; it’s a gateway offering access to new adventures. Travelers can now enjoy seamless journeys with modern amenities designed to enhance their experience from check-in to takeoff.

 

The new Ado Airport also will have the capacity for cargo transportation, opening up avenues for businesses and boosting the local economy. With advanced logistics capabilities, it’s set to become a vital hub for trade and commerce, making it easier than ever for goods to reach their destinations swiftly. Whether you’re planning your next getaway or looking to expand your business horizons, the new Ado Airport will help to elevate your travel and transport experience.
promises.description: Commence full passenger and cargo transportation at the new ado airport.

promises.title: Collaborate with the Federal Government to complete the Ilupeju and Ijesa-Isu substations and 132/33KV transmission lines.
promises.promise_blog:
For years, Ekiti State has faced persistent electricity shortages, with many communities enduring unstable supply that hampers economic growth and everyday life. The proposed completion of the Ilupeju and Ijesa‑Isu 132/33KV substations, alongside new transmission lines, represents a transformative intervention. These projects are designed to expand transmission capacity, reduce overloading on existing infrastructure, and deliver bulk power more efficiently to underserved areas across the state.

The facilities will not only improve supply to Ilupeju and Ijesa‑Isu but also strengthen distribution to the northern senatorial district and other parts of Ekiti, with a switching station planned at Ikere to stabilize the grid. Once operational, these substations will significantly reduce outages, enhance voltage quality, and support industrial clusters that depend on steady electricity.

Collaboration between the state and federal governments is central to ensuring timely completion. The Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN), working with Ekiti’s Ministry of Infrastructure and public utilities, has already begun preparations for installation. By aligning resources and oversight, the project will accelerate delivery and guarantee that Ekiti residents benefit from improved power supply.
promises.description: Collaborate with the Federal Government to complete the Ilupeju and Ijesa-Isu substations and 132/33KV transmission lines to increase the electricity supplied to Ekiti State.

promises.title: The general hospital ilawe-ekiti would be captured in the next phase of the hospital renovation project.
promises.promise_blog:
The decision to include General Hospital Ilawe-Ekiti in the next phase of the multi-stage renovation project reflects a strategic commitment to elevating healthcare standards across the region. Having successfully upgraded major referral centers in the initial phase—with modernized wards, expanded emergency units, and state-of-the-art diagnostic laboratories—the project now turns its focus to this pivotal community facility.

 

The General Hospital in Ilawe-Ekiti serves thousands of patients annually, delivering essential services such as maternal care, pediatrics, and outpatient surgery. Yet aging infrastructure, cramped wards, and outdated equipment have constrained its capacity to meet rising demand while adhering to evolving clinical protocols.  By phasing in renovation of operating theaters and provision of advanced diagnostic equipment, the hospital’s functionality and patient safety will be dramatically enhanced.

 

Renovated staff quarters, upgraded water and power systems, and modern sterilization units will not only improve working conditions for medical personnel but also drive infection control. Capturing General Hospital Ilawe-Ekiti in this renovation trajectory is more than an infrastructure upgrade; it is a decisive step toward driving operational efficiency and reaffirming the project’s overarching goal of delivering world-class healthcare to every community in the state.
promises.description: The general hospital ilawe-ekiti would be captured in the next phase of the hospital renovation project, which will be done in phases.

promises.title: The road leading to the market from the ado-ikere-akure road will be graded to ease transportation along the axis.
promises.promise_blog:
The decision to grade the road leading to the market from the Ado-Ikere-Akure artery responds directly to the relentless erosion and potholes that have long hampered transportation along this vital axis. Heavy trucks, commercial buses, and motorcyclists alike struggle with uneven surfaces that increase vehicle wear and prolong travel times. Shopkeepers along these roads have become prey to many estranged vehicles that plunge aimlessly into their makeshift kiosks, dealing them fatal injuries and sometimes death.

 

By leveling and compacting the entire stretch, a smooth carriageway is restored that withstands seasonal rains and heavy loads. Properly placed drainage channels will prevent water-logging, and reduce surface scouring. As a result, public and private transport operators can maintain reliable schedules, reducing fuel consumption and lowering fares—benefits that translate into genuine ease of access for commuters, traders, and residents. Fulfilling this promise will create a dependable transportation backbone that underpins sustained commercial growth along the Ado-Ikere-Akure axis.
promises.description: The road leading to the market from the ado-ikere-akure road will be graded to ease transportation along the axis.
